method.baseline: positive and negative _pair_ic calls with shared PairICCache RAW/RAW_FULL references and candidate cache
method.reuse: positive _pair_ic call with cache_opposite_candidate=True, then normal negative _pair_ic key lookup
method.warmup: one baseline run, then one reuse run; excluded from timing
method.timing_order: baseline three runs, then reuse three runs
method.parity: all returned float arrays matched byte-for-byte; bool arrays and scalar coverage matched exactly

estimated_memory_mib.scope: helper and key serializer arrays only; excludes QE rank scratch and process RSS

limitations: This is a synthetic paired-IC microbenchmark, not an end-to-end optimizer benchmark or a production performance claim.
Three timing samples were run sequentially in fixed baseline-then-reuse order; no confidence interval or process-RSS peak was collected.
Any finite exact-zero IC causes the helper to decline reuse so the regular exact path preserves signed-zero bytes.
